parameters.description:
`msg-to-kavenegar-sms` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Kavenegar destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through [Apprise](https://github.com/caronc/apprise), the open-source notification library, driven entirely by your own stored credentials at no cost. A paid variant ($0.001 per message) delivers to additional Kavenegar destinations bound per enrollment.

Create a Kavenegar account at kavenegar.com, then copy your API Key from your account profile at panel.kavenegar.com/client/setting/account and set it as KAVENEGAR_SMS_APIKEY. Set KAVENEGAR_SMS_TARGETS to the recipient number(s), remembering that Kavenegar wants the country code prefixed with 00 instead of a leading +.
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own Kavenegar destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

apikey_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Kavenegar apikey

targets_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Kavenegar targets
